verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (headline/sub → box → CTA) on the lime panel and keeps the box at a reasonable size. But the '48H ONLY' badge has shrunk to an unreadable blob jammed into the top-left corner over the panel edge, and the box sits off-centre and pushes above the panel. B's headline almost touches the CTA, the CTA runs off the lime panel to the canvas edge, the VOLTSTRIDE box is shrunk to a trivial size and hangs off the panel's left edge, and the '48HONLY' badge is a tiny illegible pill stuck under the subcopy.
